PowerShell($sh = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; $lnk = $sh.CreateShortcut\("$env:APPDATA\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup\\DanCore.lnk"\); Write-Output \("TargetPath: " + $lnk.TargetPath\); Write-Output \("Arguments: " + $lnk.Arguments\); Write-Output \("WorkingDir: " + $lnk.WorkingDirectory\))

PowerShell($ports = @{9000='dan-core'; 8000='sandbox'; 3000='frontend'}; $deadline=\(Get-Date\).AddSeconds\(90\); $remaining=$ports.Keys.Clone\(\); while \(\(Get-Date\) -lt $deadline -and $remaining.Count -gt 0\) { foreach \($p in @\($remaining\)\) { try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output \("[{0:HH:mm:ss}] {1} \({2}\) -> HTTP {3}" -f \(Get-Date\), $p, $ports[$p], $r.StatusCode\); $remaining=$remaining|Where-Object {$_ -ne $p} } catch { $sc=$null; try{$sc=$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__}catch{}; if\($sc\){Write-Output \("[{0:HH:mm:ss}] {1} \({2}\) -> HTTP {3} \(responding\)" -f \(Get-Date\), $p, $ports[$p], $sc\); $remaining=$remaining|Where-Object {$_ -ne $p}} } }; if\($remaining.Count -gt 0\){Start-Sleep 3} }; if \($remaining.Count -gt 0\) { Write-Output \("TIMEOUT: still down -> " + \($remaining -join ','\)\) } else { Write-Output "ALL UP" })

PowerShell($ports=@\(9000,8000,3000\); $remaining=[System.Collections.ArrayList]@\($ports\); $deadline=\(Get-Date\).AddSeconds\(90\); while \(\(Get-Date\) -lt $deadline -and $remaining.Count -gt 0\) { foreach \($p in @\($remaining\)\) { try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output \("[{0:HH:mm:ss}] port {1} -> HTTP {2}" -f \(Get-Date\), $p, $r.StatusCode\); [void]$remaining.Remove\($p\) } catch { $sc=$null; try{$sc=$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__}catch{}; if\($sc\){Write-Output \("[{0:HH:mm:ss}] port {1} -> HTTP {2} \(responding\)" -f \(Get-Date\), $p, $sc\); [void]$remaining.Remove\($p\)} } }; if\($remaining.Count -gt 0\){Start-Sleep 3} }; if \($remaining.Count -gt 0\) { Write-Output \("TIMEOUT still down: " + \($remaining -join ','\)\) } else { Write-Output 'ALL READY' })
